name: marketing-banners
title: Banners
description: Hero banner sections for marketing landing pages combining a headline, supporting copy, CTA buttons, and optional imagery in center-aligned, left-aligned, and image-paired layouts.
useWhen: Building the primary hero section at the top of a landing page or marketing site home page.
Introducing a product or feature with a headline, short description, and one or two CTA buttons.
Pairing marketing copy with a product screenshot or illustration in a two-column layout.
avoidWhen: The section is a secondary content block mid-page — use a marketing section or CTA component instead.
No image or visual reinforcement is available — a minimal text-only hero may look incomplete in these layouts.
The hero needs animated or video background — these static variants don't include media backgrounds.
responsiveBehavior: Two-column image banners collapse to a single stacked column on mobile with the image below the copy. Center-aligned variants remain centered at all widths, reducing font size on small screens.
accessibility: The banner headline should use an <h1> element — it is typically the primary page heading.
Images paired with the headline must have descriptive alt text; decorative images use empty alt.
CTA buttons must have descriptive labels — 'Get started' is ambiguous; 'Start your free trial' is better.

variants.title: Center
variants.description: Center-aligned hero with a headline, subheadline, and CTA buttons — the classic landing page opener for SaaS and product sites.
accessibility: Headline uses <h1>; CTA buttons have descriptive labels; decorative background elements are aria-hidden.

variants.title: Center (Dark)
variants.description: Center-aligned hero banner adapted for dark marketing page surfaces with light text and CTA buttons.
accessibility: Headline, subtext, and CTA button colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark banner backgrounds.

variants.title: Left
variants.description: Left-aligned hero with copy and CTA on the left and whitespace on the right — a clean layout for content-first product introductions.
accessibility: Left-aligned text follows natural reading order; ensure CTA button label clearly states the action.

variants.title: Left (Dark)
variants.description: Left-aligned hero banner adapted for dark marketing surfaces with left-anchored copy and CTAs.
accessibility: Text and button contrast must be maintained against the dark background.

variants.title: Left with image
variants.description: Two-column hero with copy and CTA buttons on the left and a product image or illustration on the right — the most common SaaS landing page layout.
accessibility: Product image must have descriptive alt text if it conveys information; the image stacks below the copy on mobile.

variants.title: Left with image (Dark)
variants.description: Two-column copy-and-image hero banner adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Image alt text and copy colors must meet contrast requirements on the dark banner background.
